chunks: The dominion will be God's on that Day; He will judge between them. Then those who had come to believe and done the right will be in gardens of delight.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the believers on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Al-Hakimiyyah* (Divine Sovereignty), affirming that on the Day of Judgment, all temporal authorities and false judges will be stripped of power, leaving only God's absolute judgment. The mention of 'Gardens of Delight' (*Jannat al-Na'im*) is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful who remained steadfast in *Tawhid* and *Adl*, highlighting the eschatological reward for those who aligned their deeds with divine will rather than worldly power.
